<!-- Release: v0.6.0 -->

Development APK for Android 8 or newer. Signed with the project development key; uses a separate `.debug` application ID. Production distribution signing is not configured.

## Changes

- Shared library, playlist, and queue browsing with list/gallery layouts and dedicated search
- Saved sorting defaults and collection overrides without changing queue or playlist order
- Long-press selection retained through canceled dialogs and failed saves
- Cached embedded artwork and manually ordered song, album, and playlist pins

## Resolved issues

- https://github.com/anastaci1a/localica/issues/15 - Consistent browsing, artwork, sorting, and selection
- https://github.com/anastaci1a/localica/issues/17 - Playback test tolerance for small timing corrections
- https://github.com/anastaci1a/localica/issues/18 - Consistent release descriptions and install steps

## Install

1. Download `localica-v0.6.0-debug.apk` from **Assets** below (Android 8+).
2. Open the APK and allow installation from your browser or file manager if prompted.
3. Open Localica and choose your music folder in Settings.
